# Belna

> Belna builds Swedish safe AI agents. Arche 1.0 is a personal AI agent built on open Kimi K3 weights with an agentic harness designed for privacy and safety.

Public information on this site is available without signing in. Personal agent workspaces require an account.

## Product

- [Belna home](https://belna.se/): Product overview and entry to the personal agent.
- [Belna app](https://belna.se/app): Sign in and use your personal agent.
- [Pricing](https://belna.se/pricing): Plans, credits, and billing information.
- [Security](https://belna.se/security): How the agent's vault, approvals, sandbox, and traces work.

## Research

- [Research index](https://belna.se/research): Model cards and research articles.
- [Arche 1.0](https://belna.se/research-arche-1-0): Production model card.
- [TAM v3 and Cortex-S](https://belna.se/research-100m): 100M-parameter research programme.
- [STLM and Mini-SLA](https://belna.se/research-stlm-sla): Small-model research and training code.
